summary: I'm a U.S. citizen, UMD mathematics major graduating May 2028, starting graduate-level coursework at UMD in 2027 while still an undergraduate. 3.9 GPA, University Honors, National Merit Scholar. Research in analytic number theory, combinatorics, and quantum algorithms; NSF-funded MathQuantum fellow. Lockheed Martin software engineering internship. Technical background: embedded systems, Verilog, Python, C++, Kubernetes/Docker/Istio. Led a 45-person STEM nonprofit serving 1,600+ students. I am NOT Pell-eligible: exclude Gilman and any Pell-restricted award. Goal: funded travel, study abroad, research placements, conference travel grants, and selective cohorts (public-interest tech, cybersecurity, AI, quantum, math). Today is 2026-09-20.
